scope: Hex improvement steps1-5; neural extension step6 remains deferred
selection: The previous development-selected RAVE-TS configuration is unchanged. Follow-up final data is not used to retune it.

suites.primary_question: Playing strength under the same 300-second external player clock, seeded streams and two root workers
Descriptive effects of removing pie choice, immediate win, immediate block, or all tactics at a fixed 16,000 total iterations

clock_allocator.interpretation: Search allowances are ceilings, not forced consumption. Full response wall time debits the actor clock, including tactics, swaps, and failed responses.

opening_and_pairs: Each seed defines one uniform forced first red stone. Both side-reversed games use the same seed, forced opening, host, executable and runner. Seeds are disjoint from previous suites; coordinates may repeat.

statistics.primary_interval: 95% bootstrap on complete side-reversal pairs, stratified by actual hardware/build signature
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Four opponent comparisons are reported descriptively; no family-wide significance claim or policy adoption is made.

stop_rule: No win-driven optional stopping of these frozen validation suites. Previously rejected bridge/order/rave_k candidate tuning remains stopped. Correctness or infrastructure failures pause jobs for diagnosis, are retained, and are never counted as playing wins.

worker_cost_plan.fixtures: Three frozen nonterminal 11x11 positions at turns2/41/81, both colours
worker_cost_plan.interpretation: Within-host benchmarks; eight workers on a four-CPU Kaggle quota do not mean eight physical cores.
worker_cost_plan.fixture_history_labels: 3 legal Red-first positions +3 explicitly static transpose-and-colour-exchange counterparts

provenance_limitations: Controlled old adapter changes runtime controls and telemetry, not the original algorithm. It is not the untouched shipped executable.
Original worker iteration cap and unbounded tree growth remain; common worker count and clock do not imply matched memory.
No bundled Davis/HexHex executable, no external ranking claim, no independent human replication claim.
publication: Preserve original source and all six old suites unchanged; add new reports, English-default/Korean docs and matching GitHub/site/source ZIP.
pre_execution_correction: Bootstrap resample count corrected to the frozen runner default of2000 before any scored follow-up game starts.
